notes.title: Leaderboard!!!
notes.notes:
Currently, our Leaderboard is fairly simple, you will be ranked by the highest score you get in-game. You can see your rank and the player around you.

The UI of Leaderboard needs to be polished in the future and maybe there are some bugs need to be fixed. 

I will include the fix and enhancements in future updates. This game is still under development in his early stages. I will do my best. 

Your understanding and patience are greatly appreciated.

notes.title: 2nd March!!! Send them to the sky
notes.notes:
[b]One week to go! send them to the sky is going to be public!!![/b]
My first game on steam is about to meet you guys!

The UI and the rules about calculating the score have changed a lot compared to the first version I posted to steam.

The game is very simple, it just sends our villagers to the sky with your magic cell, but I hope it could bring you some happiness. 
And I would keep thinking about something suitable for this game and I'm very glad to know some good points from you.

I would implement a leaderboard next step so that you can upload your high score and see who is the winner.
And I also plan to release an editing tool for you so that you could import your model to the game with sound effects or even animations and send them to the sky!

All these development consume tons of time from me. Your understanding would be appreciated. 

Currently, I still have another job to do. But I may quit my job and start focusing on game development after release!

notes.title: Hello awesome players, here is the first post from the developer.
notes.notes:
Hey!!! This game is going to meet you on 3rd March. I’m very excited because this is the first time for me to publish a game on Steam.

You may confuse about this game because it looks really simple. Is it really a game?

The answer is YES!!! I tried to make tons of games but most of them are failed because it takes too much time to design and implement and I'm the only one to do all of these.

So this time I’m trying another way. I created a simple way to “play” with our villagers in the very early stage of game development and publish with Early Access mode. I’d like to know more thoughts from my players and enrich this game step by step.

That’s all!!~
 
If you encounter any issues or you have some brilliant points of this game. Please feel free to ping me! Via:
discord: https://discord.gg/scwva2Y
Or email me directly: simplestgametech@163.com
 
Currently, I still have other jobs to do. Maybe the response would be delay. But I will respond to you definitely! Let's wait 3rd March!
